features.name: POST /api/verify verifier pipeline
features.summary: Validates the polygon, gets satellite evidence, scores the claim, stores a content-addressed evidence bundle, runs an on-chain conflict pre-check and returns a signed EIP-712 attestation only if approved.
features.registry_match: AI verifier scores monthly NDVI and signs an EIP-712 attestation

features.name: EIP-712 attestation signer
features.summary: Python signer builds the typed Attestation (tonnes, cellsHash, evidenceHash, metadataHash, deadline, random nonce) for the registry domain. The README states interoperability with the Solidity verifier is exercised by make e2e; the audit did not run it.
features.registry_match: AI verifier scores monthly NDVI and signs an EIP-712 attestation

features.name: Deterministic NDVI plausibility scoring
features.summary: Rule-based model (not trained ML, model id carbontrace-score-1.0) with weights 50/20/20/10 for vegetation, stability, claim plausibility and confidence. It has score caps for non-forest, low canopy, clearing and implausible claims, and it trims credits to capacity.
features.registry_match: AI verifier scores monthly NDVI and signs an EIP-712 attestation

features.name: Simulated satellite provider (default)
features.summary: Deterministic offline monthly NDVI series from a 12-entry biome reference table (Western Ghats, Amazon, Thar, Chennai, Rondonia and others). It is flagged simulated in all outputs and is not real imagery.

features.name: Live Sentinel-2 NDVI provider
features.summary: Queries the Element84 Earth Search STAC API and reads Red/NIR/SCL COGs via rasterio to compute cloud-masked monthly NDVI. The scene-reading path is marked no-cover and the README says it was not exercised against the network.

features.name: Polygon validation and grid-cell rasterisation
features.summary: Shapely validity, area and span checks, then rasterises to 0.002-degree global cell ids (at most 256 cells, 20% coverage rule). It must stay in sync with the contract grid constant.

features.name: Registry contract mintVerified with per-cell, per-vintage double-claim guard
features.summary: ERC1155 contract that checks recipient, deadline, nonce, minimum score 7000 bps, cellsHash and metadataHash, and the EIP-712 signature against VERIFIER_ROLE. It then claims each cell for the vintage and reverts with CellAlreadyClaimed on an overlap with a non-revoked project.
features.registry_match: Registry contract claims every land cell per year; a second claim reverts

features.name: Retire (burn) credits with beneficiary and reason
features.summary: retire() burns the caller's tokens, updates retired totals and per-account counts, and emits Retired(beneficiary, reason).

features.name: Revoke, pause and role governance
features.summary: REVOKER_ROLE revokes a project, which freezes transfers and retirement and releases its cells. PAUSER_ROLE pauses everything, and there are three roles in total (VERIFIER, REVOKER, PAUSER).

features.name: findConflict view
features.summary: A read-only pre-check the API calls before signing, to detect land already claimed for a vintage.

features.name: Hardhat contract tests, deploy script and network config
features.summary: The test file has 27 it() blocks, matching the README's 27 contract tests; the audit did not run them. deploy.js writes deployments/<network>.json with the ABI. The Hardhat config adds optional amoy and sepolia networks driven by env vars.

features.name: Content-addressed evidence store and GET /api/evidence/{hash}
features.summary: Canonical-JSON evidence bundles are keccak256-hashed and written to disk. The exact bytes are served back by hash, so the hash can be compared with the on-chain value.
features.registry_match: Content-addressed evidence bundles re-hashed in the browser

features.name: Browser re-hash integrity check on project page
features.summary: Project page fetches the raw evidence bytes, keccak256s them with ethers, and shows OK, mismatch or unavailable against the on-chain evidenceHash.
features.registry_match: Content-addressed evidence bundles re-hashed in the browser

features.name: Optional Pinata IPFS pinning
features.summary: If PINATA_JWT is set, the evidence bundle is pinned via the Pinata pinJSONToIPFS API and the metadata URI becomes ipfs://CID. Failure falls back silently to the API URL. Not exercised by the tests seen.

features.name: Auditor-style explanation (rules, with optional Claude rewrite)
features.summary: Always builds a rule-based verdict text. If ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set it asks the Anthropic Messages API to rewrite it, and the decision is never changed. It falls back silently on error.

features.name: On-chain read endpoints (projects, stats, activity, config, health)
features.summary: web3.py reader exposes GET /api/projects, /api/projects/{id}, /api/stats, /api/activity (Minted, Retired and Revoked logs), /api/config and /api/health, with 503 if no deployment file.

features.name: Fraud-lab scenario presets (GET /api/scenarios)
features.summary: Seven preset claims: legit Wayanad, double-count, fake desert, fake city, cleared forest, inflated claim and legit Oregon. They are replayed through /api/verify.

features.name: Registry page (map, ledger totals, projects table, activity feed)
features.summary: Hash route #/ shows an issuance map, issued, retired and available totals, a projects table with score and status, and a latest-activity feed.

features.name: Verify-a-project page with map polygon drawing and mint
features.summary: The user draws a polygon on a Leaflet map or loads a preset, submits the claim, sees the report, and mints the attestation on-chain with a wallet.

features.name: Fraud lab page (run all cases)
features.summary: Runs the 7 scenarios through the verifier and mints with demo wallets (developer B for the duplicate). It shows verifier and contract outcomes, and the on-chain step only works on chain 31337.

features.name: Project page retire and transfer actions
features.summary: Shows a project's facts and report, plus retire (burn with beneficiary and reason) and ERC1155 transfer forms with a balance read.

features.name: Verification report, evidence ribbon, checks and map components
features.summary: Report shows verdict, score and a simulated-data banner. EvidenceRibbon is a 12-month NDVI band chart and Checks is a pass/warn/fail list. MapView is Leaflet with Esri imagery tiles and a draw mode.

features.name: Wallet picker (demo wallets and browser wallet) with friendly revert messages
features.summary: Demo wallets are well-known Hardhat dev keys that work only on chain 31337, plus MetaMask switch-chain support. Contract custom errors are mapped to readable messages.

features.name: Hardcoded well-known Hardhat dev private keys
features.summary: Hardcoded secret present (values not recorded here). These are labelled public Hardhat dev accounts for local use only. The default verifier key falls back to one of them when VERIFIER_PRIVATE_KEY is unset, so a public deploy that forgets to set it would sign with a publicly known key.

features.name: Verifier key generator script
features.summary: Creates a fresh account and prints the VERIFIER_PRIVATE_KEY and VERIFIER_ADDRESS env lines.

features.name: End-to-end demo/smoke script and make e2e
features.summary: Walks all scenarios through verify, sign and mint, then transfer, retire, revoke and read endpoints against a live local chain and API, with PASS/FAIL checks. Not run by the audit.

features.name: Docker Compose stack and nginx proxy
features.summary: Compose runs the chain, deploy, backend and nginx frontend (port 8080, proxy of /api to the backend). The README says the Docker files are untested.

features.name: GitHub Actions CI
features.summary: Runs make install, make test and make e2e on push and pull request.

features.name: Backend pytest and frontend vitest suites
features.summary: Backend tests cover api, geo, satellite and scoring; frontend tests cover format and server render. The README claims 50 backend and 8 frontend tests; a static regex counted only top-level test functions, so the 50 and 8 are not confirmed.

features.name: Docs: architecture, threat model, deploy, demo script, Devpost
features.summary: The threat model lists single-verifier trust, unauthenticated /api/verify, sub-grid overlap and the NDVI limits. Other docs cover deployment to Amoy/Sepolia and a demo script.

limits: Read-only audit; no tests, builds or servers were run, so every test count and passing claim is from README text or static counts only.

Did not read backend/tests, contracts-pkg/test/helpers.js, frontend render.test.tsx, frontend/src/api.ts and format.ts in detail, or the Dockerfiles, package manifests and docs bodies beyond THREAT_MODEL's first 30 lines.
The contract's 27-test count matches a static count of it() calls (27); backend and frontend test counts were not reconciled with the README's 50 and 8.
No deployments/ folder was checked, so there is no evidence of a real testnet deployment.
Skipped node_modules, abi.json internals and package-lock.json. No real (non-dev) secrets were found; the hardcoded Hardhat dev keys are reported in the hardcoded-dev-keys feature.

features.name: GET /health
features.summary: Returns status ok and the service name; it is also the Render health check path.

features.name: POST /analyze-csv
features.summary: Accepts a CSV upload (.csv only, 5 MiB limit, empty and parse errors handled) and returns a quality analysis plus the SHA-256 of the uploaded bytes.

features.name: Required-column schema validation
features.summary: Rejects CSVs missing any of timestamp, location, temperature_c, humidity_pct, pm25 or source_id with HTTP 422.
features.registry_match: CSV schema validation, missing-value and duplicate detection

features.name: Missing-value and duplicate-row detection
features.summary: Counts NA per column, treats blank or whitespace-only location and source_id as missing, and counts duplicate rows.
features.registry_match: CSV schema validation, missing-value and duplicate detection

features.name: Invalid timestamp and unparseable numeric detection
features.summary: Parses timestamps with errors coerced to NaT and counts failures. Non-numeric or non-finite values in the three numeric columns are counted as invalid.
features.registry_match: Invalid timestamp and humidity/PM2.5 range checks with IQR outlier signals

features.name: Humidity (0-100) and PM2.5 (>=0) range checks
features.summary: Counts values outside the configured domain ranges as violations. Temperature has no range rule.
features.registry_match: Invalid timestamp and humidity/PM2.5 range checks with IQR outlier signals

features.name: Descriptive stats and IQR outlier counts
features.summary: Per-column count, mean, min, max and std, plus 1.5xIQR outlier counts. The response note states that outliers are not proof of fraud. It is statistical, not a trained model.
features.registry_match: Invalid timestamp and humidity/PM2.5 range checks with IQR outlier signals

features.name: POST /verify-csv (hash match)
features.summary: Compares the uploaded file's SHA-256 with a caller-supplied expected 64-hex hash using a constant-time compare.
features.registry_match: File-integrity verification and downloadable integrity report

features.name: POST /integrity-report and /integrity-report/download
features.summary: Returns a v1.0 JSON report (dataset hash, quality block, warnings, limitations; verification_status is always not_verified). The download endpoint serves it as an attachment named integrity_report.json.
features.registry_match: File-integrity verification and downloadable integrity report

features.summary: Sidebar API URL with a health check, CSV upload and analyze, metrics, SHA-256 display, line charts for temperature, humidity and PM2.5, warnings, hash-verification form, JSON report view and download.
features.registry_match: File-integrity verification and downloadable integrity report

features.name: Synthetic sample CSV

features.name: Nightly NASA FIRMS VIIRS fetch (3 satellites)
features.summary: Downloads the Suomi NPP, NOAA-20 and NOAA-21 VIIRS 7-day CSVs, keeps night detections in the Niger Delta box (3.8-7.0N, 4.5-9.0E), and writes one write-once canonical JSON per complete UTC day. Existing published files are never rewritten.
features.registry_match: Nightly NASA FIRMS VIIRS detections from three satellites

features.name: Canonical day file and SHA-256 digest
features.summary: Sorted, compact JSON day files with a trailing newline are hashed with SHA-256. Six day files exist, for 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-20.
features.registry_match: Write-once SHA-256 of each night anchored on a Solana program

features.name: Solana Anchor program (initialize, record_day)
features.summary: initialize creates the registry PDA with a fixed method_digest. record_day, authority-only, creates a DayRecord PDA via init, so a second write for the same day fails. It validates the date, rejects future days, rejects a zero digest and checks detections >= flare_sites. There is no update or delete instruction.
features.registry_match: Write-once SHA-256 of each night anchored on a Solana program

features.name: anchor.mjs on-chain recorder and tamper check
features.summary: Creates the registry if missing, with the METHOD.md hash. For each day file it sends record_day, or if the day already exists it compares the on-chain digest and logs MISMATCH. anchors.json holds a tx and account for each recorded day (first three entries seen).
features.registry_match: Write-once SHA-256 of each night anchored on a Solana program

features.name: Method document hash fixed in registry
features.summary: initialize stores the SHA-256 of METHOD.md. The web app can verify it against the registry account bytes. The persistent-flare rule itself runs off-chain and only the document hash is on-chain.
features.registry_match: Persistent-flare rule (3+ nights in 7 days) with a method hash fixed on-chain

features.name: 1 km clustering and persistent-flare classification
features.summary: Single-linkage clustering at 1 km via a grid-accelerated union-find, then a site is a persistent flare if it appears on at least 3 nights within a 7-day span. Rule-based, not a trained model. index.json totals: 91 sites, 48 flares, 675 detections.
features.registry_match: Persistent-flare rule (3+ nights in 7 days) with a method hash fixed on-chain

features.name: derive.mjs site and index builder
features.summary: Builds sites.json (per-site nights, FRP stats, place) and index.json (totals, per-day digest and stats, anchor links, program and registry ids, methodSha256 hardcoded). The hardcoded methodSha256 is a hash, not a secret.

features.name: OpenStreetMap Nominatim place naming
features.summary: Reverse-geocodes each new site to state and area at one request per 1.2 s, cached in places.json. Sites with no state become 'Offshore or coast'.

features.name: AI brief with number-checking and template fallback
features.summary: Sends pre-phrased facts to Groq (gpt-oss-120b, then 20b). It rejects the output if any number is not in the facts or it has an em dash or is over 110 words, and falls back to a template without GROQ_API_KEY. The committed brief.json source reads 'AI (openai/gpt-oss-120b, Groq)'.

features.name: Daily GitHub Actions pipeline
features.summary: Cron at 06:30 UTC runs fetch, derive, places, anchor (only if the FLAREWATCH_SECRET secret is set), derive and brief, then commits web/data. The secret is read from repository secrets, not hardcoded.

features.name: Static web app: Leaflet map, stats, flare table, state filter, nightly bars
features.summary: Single-page site on Leaflet with Esri dark basemap. It shows persistent flares versus other hotspots with popups, flares by state, detections per night, a filterable flare table that zooms the map, and the AI brief card.

features.name: Ledger section with in-browser verification against Solana
features.summary: For each night, it fetches the day file, hashes it with WebCrypto SHA-256, reads the DayRecord account via devnet JSON-RPC getAccountInfo, and compares bytes 12-44. It also has verify-all and verify-method buttons.
features.registry_match: Write-once SHA-256 of each night anchored on a Solana program

features.name: LiteSVM program tests
features.summary: Five #[test] cases cover recording and registry counters, no rewrite, authority-only, bad input and no double initialize. There are also 2 unit tests in lib.rs. Not run by the audit.

features.name: Anchor IDL, Anchor.toml (devnet), vercel static config
features.summary: The IDL declares the program id 9fWT... with instructions initialize and record_day and the DayRecord account. Anchor.toml sets the devnet cluster, and vercel.json serves web/ statically with a 300 s cache on /data.

features.name: METHOD.md and DEVPOST docs
features.summary: METHOD.md has the formal detection and classification spec, and a copy is served from web/. Honest limits cover FRP not being gas volume and cloud hiding flares.

limits: Read-only audit; nothing run, so the 'live' status of the web app and the on-chain state at devnet could not be confirmed. Only the first lines of anchors.json were read, and it was not confirmed that there is an account and tx for every one of the 6 days.

The registry evidence '48 persistent flares across 91 hotspot sites and 675 detections' matches web/data/index.json totals (days 6, sites 91, flares 48, detections 675); the Rivers 20 / Delta 13 / Bayelsa 6 / Edo 4 breakdown was not checked.
Did not read the Cargo manifests, Cargo.lock, the full IDL, docs/DEVPOST.md body, web/style.css or the per-day JSON beyond existence.

The registry claim 'Write-once ... anchored' relies on the program not exposing update or delete; confirmed in lib.rs. The deployed program was not checked, so a different upgraded binary on devnet is possible.
No hardcoded secrets found; the keypair comes from an env var or ~/.config/solana/id.json, and Groq and Solana keys come from env or GitHub secrets.
